**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** (No blockers; reviewed under the high tier - safety floor, a placement changes posted coordinates.)

### What looks good
- Same command as the GUI (Everything Is a Command): `set_part_axes` now builds `AlignPartToSetup::align_from_axes` (`crates/app/src/mcp/align_tools.rs:68`), the exact call the GUI's Apply drains (`crates/ui/src/state.rs:3549-3550`, queued from `crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_axis_pick.rs:74`). Both go through `crates/app/src/commands/setup_align.rs:242` -> `pick::align_from_axes`, then `history.execute`: one undo step per apply.
- Refusals before any world write: all validation (axis picks, parallel/zero/Z-only axes, unknown setup/part) happens in `axis_of` / `in_plane_turn_deg` / `align_from_axes`, all of which run before `env.history.execute` (`align_tools.rs:61-69`); a failure returns the command's own text as a tool error. Parallel picks are pinned ("along each other").
- Left-handed acceptance is not MCP-local logic; it is the shared `pick::align_from_axes`, so MCP and GUI cannot differ. The old MCP-only refusal came from `turn_in_plane`, which is now bypassed for two axes.
- One axis still falls back to the in-plane turn inside the command; `turn_deg` is computed as before and the reply gains `frame: "in_plane"`. Pinned (90 deg turn, undo).
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` added outside tests; new test file carries a header and gate map; skill row, tool description, decision file (`docs/decisions/1329-mcp-align-from-axes.md`) and the `Changelog:` / `Fixes #1329` lines are in place; no snapshot PNGs, no `build.rs`/scripts/dependency changes.
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` 45 -> 46 (main is at 45), camcraft-mcp `SKILL.md` updated.

### Local results (trial-merged with upstream/main; merge was clean and needed nothing, #1348 already in)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `mcp_align_axes` | 1/1 |
| `mcp` | 19/19 |
| `mcp_setup` | 8/8 |
| `mcp_pick` / `mcp_wcs_features` | 6/6, 2/2 |
| `align_axes` / `axis_align` | 9/9, 10/10 |
| `setup_wcs` / `wcs_align` / `wcs_roles` | 7/7, 5/5, 9/9 |
| `camcraft-app --lib` | 154/154 |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Mutation check:** swapped `align_from_axes` back to `turn_in_plane` in `set_part_axes`; `set_part_axes_with_both_axes_aligns_the_full_3d_frame` went red (panic at `mcp_align_axes.rs:74`). Reverted.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` 46 collides with #759's 46; whichever merges second renumbers (as the PR already says).
2. The "twin" assertion compares the MCP result to hand-derived expected landings (`lands_on`) rather than to the GUI command's output on the same picks. Since both paths call the one `align_from_axes`, this is sufficient today; a direct `AlignPartToSetup::align_from_axes` vs MCP equality check would guard a future divergence.
3. Everything lives in one `#[test]` fn (full frame, left-handed, undo, one-axis, parallel). Splitting would localise failures; the mutation above shows it does catch the regression.
4. Follow-up #1347 (re-apply is a no-op undo step) is a pre-existing GUI-identical behaviour, agreed out of scope.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
